eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Nine
subtitle: Lesson 79 · Window and Ranking Functions

code:
SELECT Name, Color, ListPrice,
  AVG(ListPrice) OVER (PARTITION BY Color)
    AS AvgPriceForColor
FROM Production.Product;
caption: Unlike GROUP BY, every individual product row still appears.

steps.label: GROUP BY
steps.sub: one row per group — the rest disappear

steps.label: OVER() / PARTITION BY
steps.sub: every row kept, group value attached

eyebrow: PARTITION BY — you've seen this before
code:
SELECT Name, Color, ListPrice,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY Color)
    AS ProductsInThisColor
FROM Production.Product;
caption: Same tool from Lesson 51's deduplication trick — now explained properly.
